standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145048Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after two fixes (report 3649 blocks filed under the month holding most of their days, with the earlier 2026-10 rows flagged SUPERSEDED; ams_chicken_monthly declared accumulates, so the month-over-month comparison is available). The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-11-02 by a session from numbers.md, then revised on an independent review that recalculated every headline figure from the captured reports (all matched, and matched numbers.json) and required four changes: report 3649 prints its previous month too and the slaughter report a last-week row, so the text no longer says each states one period, and the record section now says what the earlier runs actually support (the August figures from the report of September 1, matching the October 2 report's previous-month columns; the four earlier slaughter weeks only the count of five weeks); 'within the latest reporting month' became 'from the August to the September reporting month', with a note that the six rows are not the whole report and the boneless thigh average rose; the summary sentences now carry the retail falls (bone-in legs, ERS retail composite) instead of 'retail barely moved'; and the first year-over-year for report 3649 needs the August 2027 block, a thirteenth reading in the report due about the start of September 2027, not 'twelve months'. Clarifications applied: 'September' named as this record's label for the 8/31 to 10/2 block; the report has a regional destination-pricing section, so it names no shipping point for the parts and no destination for the national composite; 'weight classes in pounds' not 'live-weight classes'; the ERS composite's calendar September distinguished from report 3649's block; the six earlier runs listed by id (2026-09-23T150831Z holds only a BLS capture and is rightly not in evidence.json); the buyer's question gives the retail measures both ways. tools/check.py passes. Known limits stated in the text: no year-over-year for report 3649 until the August 2027 block; whole bird delivered, every parts row FOB; bone-in thighs the thinnest row; no thigh figure and the boneless thigh price range not quoted (the October 2 report prints it '1.57 - 186.00', most likely a misprint for 157); the report spells out neither 'B/S' nor 'WOG' and the text says it reads B/S as boneless skinless; slaughter preliminary with an undated comparable week; BLS marks October 2025 unavailable for both CPIs and all three average prices, so the next issue's October rows for those five series carry no year-earlier figure. For the editor: (1) the boneless thigh row (155.11 cents on 3,000 thousand lb, up from 148.82) trades more pounds than whole wings and is not in issue.py's computed set; adding it would need a regenerated numbers.json, so the text says only that it rose. (2) methodology.md gives report 3649's cadence as 'first business day, for the month just ended', but the report for the September block is dated Friday October 2, the last day of its own period; not changed here. (3) OWNER-ACTIONS says 'until the record holds twelve months'; the first comparison needs a thirteenth reading. (4) BLS series titles and the PPI import exclusion rest on sources.json and BLS definitions, not on a retained file. (5) The next-issue date, November 13, 2026, matches the pork and cheddar issues and is not in any capture. The verification gate reads no bare count or worded quantity: the five- and four-week blocks, five slaughter weeks, six earlier runs, six rows, six kinds of measure, five series without an October 2025 value, the report dates and weekdays were checked by hand against the captures by the drafter and again by the reviewer. Publication is gated only by FA-D-20261018-01: one title at a time, through the review step. The editor read and signed the result on 2026-11-02.
